name: Kimi wa Itoshiki Madouka no Esa
original_name: 君は愛しき魔導花の餌
source:
A story about a girl who, after arriving in another world, becomes food for a mysterious researcher’s flower.

[From [url=https://sia-morino.itch.io/you-are-the-beloved-feed-of-the-mageblossom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
讲述了一个女孩来到异世界后，成为神秘研究员之花的食物的故事。

[来自[url=https://sia-morino.itch.io/you-are-the-beloved-feed-of-the-mageblossom]Itch.io[/url]]
